lines: Wait... what?
Since when is there a block here?
This is my usual way home and I definitely can't get through like this.
Guess I need to find another way around.
Welcome to the tutorial.
It's dangerous walking alone at night.
Find 3 batteries and use your flashlight to see.
Stay quiet, hide if you hear something, and come back to me when you have them.
You made it. The tutorial is over.
Head back to the lobby and pick a difficulty. Don't get caught.
Hey there, you look like you could use some help.
I have a quest for you. Don't get caught by the cops, they will take all your stuff and put you in jail.
You actually made it this far.
This is the easy route. The cheap way.
Don't get comfortable. This is the real world now.
Good luck getting home.
Jayden: Hey... sorry to bother you. I just need a bit of help.
My phone's dying. I need some batteries... and an energy drink. I'm exhausted.
Granny: Go on inside, love. Look around. Take what you need.
While you're at it... could you find my husband? He should be out in the garden.
Come back to me when you've got your things.
Local man reported missing after a neighbourhood dispute...
That was months ago. Why would she keep this?
That's her... and that's supposed to be her husband.
But why is his face  crossed out?
Wait... what?
What the hell...
She killed him. That's a grave.
I need to get out of here.
Jayden:What was that out there? There's a grave. You killed him.
Granny: Ha... I forgot I did that.
I hope you got all your things, dear, you don't wanna end up next to him.
You should be going now. Home's still a long walk.
Hey little guy... where did you come from?
Who do you belong to?
Wait!
This must be the house.
The kid said the old man took the dog in here.
Old man: You looking for that dog?
I took it because it was barking all the time.
That kid needs to learn to keep its pets away from me.
Or he's gonna get it.
There you are.
Let's get you out of here.
The dog's safe.
I should get home.
Strange man: Oh. Hey. It's you again. How you doing?
Jayden: I'm alright. Just heading home.
Strange man: Yeah. You should just make sure you get home safe. It's quite a dangerous neighbourhood around here.
Jayden: Okay. Cool.
Wait... what the hella?
Did that guy seriously steal my keys and my wallet
I need to find him. There's no way I can go home without them now.
Maybe there's someone I can ask for help.
Grandma: Yes, dear?
Jayden: Hi, sorry to bother you. A man I was just talking to took my keys and my wallet. I need to find him. Do you know where he stays?
Grandma: Oh... I wouldn't know about that.
But the man next door knows just about everyone around here. You should ask him.
You look a little tired too. If you need anything, take what you need inside.
Oh, wait! Before you go, could you help me with something?
I've been trying to move this thing all morning, but I can't manage it on my own.
Jayden: Yeah, sure. Where do you want it?
Grandma: There. That's perfect. Thank you, dear.
Go ask the man next door. He'll probably know where that man stays.
Jayden: Okay. Thanks.
What's that noise?
Someone's getting hurt in there.
Let me check the gate.
It's locked.
I need to find another way around.
This way's open.
I should get inside and check on her.
Jayden: Are you okay?
Woman: I'm fine.
Jayden: I heard shouting.
Woman: You shouldn't be here.
Jayden: I was just trying to see if you needed help.
Woman: You need to leave.
Jayden: What's happening?
Woman: He does this all the time.
Jayden: You should leave.
Woman: I know. But you need to worry about yourself right now.
He's still downstairs. If he finds you in this house, he's going to come after you too.
Jayden: Wait. Someone stole my wallet and keys. Do you know who he is?
Woman: I know who you're talking about. He lives in the last house on the street.
People go there looking for their things all the time. If your stuff is there, you're probably going to have to take it back yourself.
Jayden: Okay. Thank you.
Woman: Just be careful.
Thank God I'm out of that house.
Now it's time to find that man and get my stuff.
Jayden: Why'd you steal my stuff?
Strange man: Don't take it personal. It's just business.
But I kinda like you, so you can go get it yourself.
Just don't trust anyone in there.
That's mine.
Okay. Now I need to find my keys. I definitely can't leave without those.
Finally.
I can finally go home.
